title: Postmortem: crossplane-provider-write-storm
description: Epic for the 2026-10-15 crossplane provider status-write storm. Postmortem: .agents/postmortems/2026-10-15-crossplane-provider-write-storm/PM.md. Root cause: unmerged async-callback status-write fix (upstream PR merged 2026-10-14, package never bumped past v1.15.0); ~1.5 resource-version bumps/sec conflict storm saturated kube-apiserver, wedged one app sync mid-flight and made a second sync error while the app still reported Synced.
notes: Runbook quick-ref. Symptom: ControlPlaneAPIUnreachable / KubeAPIServerSlow (blackbox probe >2s for 5m), kube-apiserver ~3 cores, apps stuck Progressing/OutOfSync despite pushed commits. Diagnose: kubectl logs -n crossplane-system -l pkg.crossplane.io/provider=provider-proxmox-bpg | grep -c 'conflict: too many requests' (count climbing = active storm). Stop: pause provider reconciles via crossplane.io/paused annotations (exact blocks in tk-ac9 notes, commit 4df62139). Resume: bump provider pkg past v1.15.0, then unpause. New coverage: k8s/charts/support-cluster/templates/monitoring/argocd-sync.yaml (ArgoCDAppSyncFailed / ArgoCDAppSyncPendingStuck / ArgoCDAppOutOfSync); cluster-cache alert in argocd.yaml unaffected. ClusterCacheDown stays green in this failure mode - do not treat it as sufficient.
